description: Crosstalk epistemic swarm & falsification engine — Stress-tests a research question instead of answering it once. Classifies the domain, generates up to 3 independent hypotheses, attacks each with an adversarial falsification pass, checks live literature on arXiv and OpenAlex (plus any papers you supply by arXiv id or DOI; every record content-addressed by sha256), then synthesizes a calibrated answer. context.description: Optional background, constraints, data or prior attempts.

maxHypotheses.description: Independent hypotheses to generate and attack (default 3).

papers.description: Up to 5 papers you already have, as arXiv ids or URLs (2201.11903, arxiv.org/abs/...) or DOIs (10.xxxx/..., doi.org URLs). They are fetched and become citable evidence records alongside the live literature search.

question.description: The question or claim to deliberate.

name: crosstalk-deliberate
